note: Alberta Parks recreation area on the Tay River, 16 km southwest of Caroline on Hwy 591: most sites are in an open grassy field inside a bend of the river, with a picnic shelter. The area has OHV and equestrian trails nearby; OHVs must stay on their trailers until they reach the trail systems and staging areas, and horses are not permitted in the park. Bring firewood. --Claude
